auditMode: Read-only independent evidence-quality audit; only /tmp output; no live fetch, project edits or publication approvals.
method: Read all 66 cities and 528 decisions; compare all excerpts at recorded offsets against saved fetched.json full source text. This verifies saved extraction, not live website authenticity or continued currency.
Follow-up script stores full source bodies in fetched.json; hashed files in followup-fetch belong to another extraction and are not assumed identical.
Existing/new classification uses exact URL membership in central.json per city, not whether the follow-up generated a new source ID.
Usable means service-relevant narrowly scoped context, not meaningful commercial service copy. Emergency management is not equated with security consulting.
Additional tool discovery is mentioned by report but no complete query/result ledger was supplied; successful discovery count is unknown, not inferred from fetches.

globalCorrections.correction: Replace searched completion language with query attempts; no usable-result attempts count toward successful or exhaustive discovery.

Reject generic padding: city has documented context relevant to service + clipped quote + boilerplate disclaimer is not a meaningful local service paragraph. Even retained evidence needs specific institution, operative scope, date/status and a complete quote.

Official municipal/institutional record at URL is provenance shorthand, not institution verification. Explicitly identify BIA, shared transit committee, City corporate policy, county, or private-property advice as appropriate.

Dates visible in actual records can be recorded with context: Brampton ANI-110 effective 2025-04-02; Cambridge release 2026-05-05; Kingston policy effective 2017-10-04; Picton county policy approval 2024-05-21/review 2027-05-21; Windsor effective 2021-11-15; Woodstock fire-risk report 2025-04-02; Thorold incident release 2026-06-01. Do not normalize URL year tokens into current deployment.
